chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The first thing about which a servant will be questioned is the love for us, the People of the Household.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the Household (Ahl al-Bayt), referring to the Prophet's family and Imams
key_terms.حُبُّنَا: Our love (referring to the love for the Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the first thing a person will be questioned about according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, establishes love for the Ahl al-Bayt as the foundational criterion for divine accountability, distinguishing it as the first question posed to the believer on the Day of Judgment. In Shia scholarship, this is often linked to the concept of 'Wilayah' (spiritual authority), where affection for the Prophet's purified household serves as the gateway to true faith and salvation. It underscores that theological belief is intrinsically tied to emotional and spiritual connection with the Imams.
